scope: Characterize PlayerSearch / RetainerSearch / FriendSearch / ItemSearch opcodes in the 0x01C3..0x01E1 range. The search subsystem pass is a synthesis + targeted-Ghidra pass: it cross-references the existing cluster-0x01c3-0x01df-subsystems.md document, the existing operation_opcode_map_outbound.json c2s attributions, and 4 new Ghidra symbol queries + 5 new opcode-immediate scans + 1 new decomp batch.

method.step3_ghidra_symbols: New Ghidra queries via tools/ghidra-scripts/FindSymbolByName.java: 'Search' (159 hits), 'Retainer' (85 hits), 'Friend' (0 hits). Key new RTTI classes surfaced beyond the 3 ItemSearch* widgets already cataloged: ItemSearchListWidget (3 vftables, multi-inherited), ItemSearchListHelpWidget (2 vftables), PcSearchCallback, PcSearchDebugCallback, PcSearchSelectWidgetCallback, PcSearchWidgetOperator, PcSearchSelectWidgetOperator, PcSearchContractor (6 PcSearch classes - the player search UI subsystem), ElementFactory::SearchInfoInterface, RetainerListWidget, RetainerMenuPhase, RetainerNameChangeInputLoader, CharaMakeParamTmpl<UpdateRetainerSlotParam_,1>. 'Friend' query returned ZERO RTTI hits - friend functionality is NOT a distinct subsystem but is implemented via PcSearch + chat IPC dispatch.
method.step4_opcode_immediates: New FindOpcodeImmediate.java scans for 0x01D7 (16 hits, 1 real emitter), 0x01D8 (391 hits - mostly struct-offset noise, 1 real PUSH-imm emitter at FUN_0051AAC0), 0x01DF (6 hits, 1 real emitter), 0x01E0 (523 hits - all struct-offset / malloc / no real PUSH-imm into the FUN_004E0240 forwarder), 0x01E1 (6 hits, 1 PUSH-imm but openssl false-positive). Confirms no client-side c2s emitter for 0x01E0 or 0x01E1.
method.step5_decomp_validation: DumpFunctionDecomp.java batch on 9 candidate VAs: FUN_0045F3E0/FUN_00461900/FUN_004A10F0/FUN_00485780/FUN_00498A90 all confirmed as openssl false positives (refs `.\crypto\asn1\tasn_dec.c`, `.\crypto\ec\ec_asn1.c`, `.\crypto\ec\ec2_smpl.c`, `.\crypto\ec\ec_mult.c` source line numbers - same false-positive class the pcap grounded c2s validation pass documented for 0x01DD). FUN_00519440 confirmed real c2s 0x01D7 emitter (local_8b0 = 0x1d7, size 0x18 -> FUN_004E0240 forwarder - same Tier-D shape as BCS-Y-0325). FUN_0051A970 confirmed real c2s 0x01DF emitter (local_9b0 = 0x1df, size 0x128 = 296 bytes - 0x118 = 280 visible payload bytes + 16 bytes for game-msg header, distinct shape). FUN_0051AAC0 confirmed real c2s 0x01D8 emitter (local_8b0 = 0x1d8 -> FUN_004E0240). FUN_004E44B0's PUSH 0x1e0 is malloc(0x1e0) bookkeeping (480-byte alloc), NOT a packet emitter.
method.step6_cross_ref: BCS-Y-0325 already documented 0x01DD c2s emitter (FUN_004C7300) via FUN_004C7150 passthrough + FUN_004E0240 forwarder. Confirmed via pcap friendlist_search.pcapng. The cluster-doc emitter findings (BCS-Y-0324, BCS-Y-0325/0326/0327) collectively confirm c2s emission of 0x01D7-0x01DF.

false_positives_filtered.method: Decomp validation of every PUSH-imm candidate confirms openssl source line number false positives for: 0x01D7 PUSH at FUN_0045F3E0 (.\crypto\asn1\tasn_dec.c), 0x01D7 PUSH at FUN_00461900 (asn.1), 0x01D7 PUSH at FUN_004A10F0 (.\crypto\ec\ec2_smpl.c:0x1d7), 0x01DF PUSH at FUN_00485780 (.\crypto\ec\ec_asn1.c:0x1bc/0x1f5), 0x01E1 PUSH at FUN_00498A90 (.\crypto\ec\ec_mult.c:0x1e1). Pattern identical to the pcap grounded c2s validation pass's 7-of-11 false-positive rate for 0x01DD scans. The openssl crypto/ source-line PUSH-imm pattern is a known systematic false-positive class for opcode scans on this binary.
false_positives_filtered.implication: Future c2s opcode scans in the 0x01C0..0x01FF range should expect ~30% openssl false-positive rate; pre-filter by checking the function decomp for `FUN_0045c940(*,*,*,'.\crypto\*',*)` calls.
